notes: Lost: XANES/EXAFS spectra, BET, Cu2O templates, hollow-vs-solid LSV and post-test TEM sit in the SI, so amorphous local structure, template inheritance, the architecture gain and structural stability rest on text_only nodes; activity is per geometric area with no ECSA normalisation, and TOF (0.18 s-1) is a lower bound. The argument branches after synthesis into a composition line (EDS/XPS -> DFT O* binding -> volcano, joined only by rank correlation of F3b and F4b over four shared compositions, with the reactivity-activity link labelled 'deduction' in F5), an architecture line (hollow vs solid, attributed) and an amorphous-state line to 10 h stability. Image audits: the headline eta = 0.25 V onset is not resolved in F3a (eta10 = 0.35 V is, and F3c agrees), the EDS spectrum is dominated by Cu with S present while the formula omits both, and F2b shows debris the text denies; the F3e ring current is ~-140 uA, not small, and F3f closes the charge balance at ~2% peroxide.

changes: o15 relabelled as a non-resolution audit: F3a cannot resolve a sub-mA onset at 1.48 V on its 0-20 mA cm-2 axis (does not resolve, not contradicts); qualifies f1 kept.
m1 attrs.basis evidenced -> argued: F5 itself labels the reactivity->activity link 'deduction', and the only support is a 4-composition rank match (o23).
o23 provenance computed -> derived, with new derives edges from o11 (measured j) and o22 (DFT E_SB) so the audit's inputs are explicit.
Filled modality on figure-bearing non-OBS nodes: p1 and m1 schematic, k2 simulation_render.
key_multimodal_steps: Correlate across series, measured vs computed (F3b x F4b -> m1): the measured j(1.60 V) volcano and the DFT O* binding curve share rank order at 0, 33, 100% Co and a peak near 67-73% Co; this is the paper's only bridge from reactivity to activity.
Convert ring/disk currents to a charge balance (F3e -> o18, F3f -> o19): FE = I_ring/(I_disk N) ~0.97-0.99 plus ~2% peroxide from the co-plotted ring current closes the 4e- claim for f2.

Register the EDS line scan on the TEM cage (F2c-d) and read the EDS spectrum against the formula (F2e): Co/Ni rise at both walls (hollow shell), while Cu and S peaks appear that the stated NiCo2.7(OH)x omits.
review.audit_summary: Confirmed o2 (F2b debris contradicts 'exclusively nanocages'), o8 (Cu/S in the EDS spectrum, source unresolved) and o23 (volcano match rests on 4 shared compositions). Reframed, not overturned, o15: the 0.25 V onset is not resolved by F3a rather than contradicted.
